title: Scientific visualization with Plotly: Python and JavaScript
summary: Eight paired lessons on data encodings, distributions, uncertainty, interactive inspection, forecasting, model comparisons, bounded rendering and accessible figure evidence.

lessons.title: Data, traces and honest encodings
lessons.outcome: Preserve record identity, units and exact values while sorting and rendering a chart.
lessons.lab: Use the supplied fixture to complete the six data, traces and honest encodings tasks and compare the numerical and visual evidence.
lessons.verification: Check the named values and failure case in the guide; the reference prints viz-001 Plotly complete after creating its figure.
